evidence: Labeled Kernel, adds btck_chainstate_manager_set_clock_time in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h and separates nondeterministic clock symbols from libbitcoinkernel.
rationale: Decoupling libbitcoinkernel from the global system clock allows callers to run validation deterministically in concurrent instances without global state. PR description notes this provides an instance-scoped API so 'kernel applications run validation code deterministically without depending on the system clock'.
